================================================================================
AcadsCatchUp Desktop Client — Linux Quick Start Guide
================================================================================

PREREQUISITE:
Java 21 or later is required (OpenJDK 21).

To check if Java 21 is installed:
  java -version

If not installed, install it using your distribution's package manager:
  • Ubuntu / Debian / Linux Mint:
      sudo apt update && sudo apt install openjdk-21-jre -y
  • Fedora / RHEL / AlmaLinux:
      sudo dnf install java-21-openjdk -y
  • Arch Linux / Manjaro:
      sudo pacman -S jre21-openjdk
  • openSUSE:
      sudo zypper install java-21-openjdk

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
HOW TO RUN:
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

OPTION 1: Double-Click Shell Script
  1. Make sure Launch_AcadsCatchUp.sh is executable:
       chmod +x Launch_AcadsCatchUp.sh
  2. Double-click "Launch_AcadsCatchUp.sh" (select "Run as a Program" if prompted).

OPTION 2: Double-Click the Standalone JAR
  1. Right-click "AcadsCatchUp.jar" -> Open With -> "OpenJDK Java 21 Runtime".
  2. Or double-click if .jar file associations are enabled.

OPTION 3: Terminal Command
  Open terminal in this directory and run:
       ./Launch_AcadsCatchUp.sh
  OR:
       java -jar AcadsCatchUp.jar

OPTION 4: Desktop Entry
  1. Allow launching:
       chmod +x AcadsCatchUp.desktop
  2. Double-click "AcadsCatchUp.desktop" or copy to ~/.local/share/applications/
